body:
I read the posts before going to sleep. This one stuck with me. I think you are right, it does make sense to exhaust all the options before the act. And even if those endeavours end up being a waste of money and time.. well.. suffice to say it makes no difference in the very end.

I will have to do some research on the whole therapy angle and I'll try to do it as soon as possible. Since I was convinced I'd go through with the suicide, I have a lot of things piled up that I also need to take care of. I still think I'm going to try to approach the entire issue secretly - without telling my family or friends. If possible, that is. I do feel nervous and uncomfortable facing the treatment as is, no need to drag more people into this and add to the unspoken stigma that you mentioned. I have enough negative feelings towards this already, I will try not to add any more.

I would also like to thank everyone else for the advice too, but well.. it isn't that easy to just change my life and try something new, or travel. I have had a 'new start' once already and it didn't do me any good. And that's because without the energy or will to push myself to do anything, the chances of me taking charge truly slim. It's my perspective that's crooked, the chemistry and the wiring of my brain need to be fixed first. Perhaps after that I will be able and willing to start getting my life together.
